title: Compass and Regiment
author: Quentin Yarrow
blurb: Sable Sterling, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
